title: Slop reduction
summary: Extracts the direction between prose written with forced cliches and purple prose, and the same prompts written plainly. Ablating that direction reduces flowery, formulaic prose.

advice: Start at 0.3. Slop and plainness are two ends of one register axis, so this direction tends to be strong; if prose goes flat, step down to 0.2. Raise toward 0.5 only if the check still shows marker phrases.
